title: warm Jamaican Cheese Jamaican clotted cream Pilaf
description: nutty, cheese-pull, festive Jamaican dish featuring clotted cream, soffritto-base, macrobiotic-friendly, vessel=salt-block. Perfect for special occasions or cozy nights in.
instructions: heat the butter in a large salt-block skillet over medium heat.
add the onions, carrots, and garlic to the skillet and saut0 until the vegetables are tender.
add the jamaican allspice and jamaican thyme to the skillet and stir to combine.
add the flour to the skillet and stir to combine.
slowly add the chicken broth to the skillet, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes.
stir in the clotted cream and sharp cheddar cheese until the cheese is melted and the mixture is smooth.
season the pilaf with salt and nutritional yeast to taste.
serve the pilaf hot, garnished with additional nutritional yeast if desired.
transfer the pilaf to a baking dish and top with additional sharp cheddar cheese.
bake the pilaf in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
